name: Eaton Park
location: Sarjapur - Marathahalli Rd, Yamare Village, Bengaluru 562125
configurations: 4 Bed Supreme (4 BHK + 4 Toilet + Home Office)
price: 3 Bed Premia from ₹228 Lakhs; 4 Bed Supreme from ₹305 Lakhs (incl. carpark, price w.e.f 15 June 2026)
overview: Eaton Park is part of The Prestige City, Sarjapur — a 200+ acre self-contained community of high-rise towers, plots and villas that includes multiple clubhouses and a Forum Mall. Spanning over 7 acres with 90% open space, Eaton Park offers 3 Bed Premia and 4 Bed Supreme residences designed for natural light, cross ventilation and spatial fluidity.
